rows.after: Jeremiah composed a lament for Josiah. To this day all the male and female singers speak of Josiah in their laments. They made these a lasting practice in Israel, and they are written in the Laments.
rows.tsw_comparator: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the male and female singers spoke about Josiah in their laments to this day. They made them an ordinance in Israel. Look, they are written in the Laments.
